# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest release line.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues.

Instead, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting via the **"Report a vulnerability"**
button on the repository's [Security advisories](https://github.com/dereuromark/cakephp-reactions/security/advisories/new)
page.

You will receive a response as soon as possible. Once the issue is confirmed and a fix
is prepared, a new release is published and the advisory disclosed.
